name: The King Solomon Salami Stroker
description: The Solomon concept takes its silhouette from the clasped bronze hands and its bedroom inspiration from Proverbs 5:19 in the KJV. Its broad palm shape puts the emphasis on gentle, sweeping contact.
finishes: Warm bronze with darker recesses and polished knuckles.
A brighter gold tone along the fingers and wrist band.
artDescription: Concept rendering of two wide, rounded bronze hands with a polished gold wrist band
